question.text: Department of Revenue under Ministry of Finance handles:

answer.text: Direct and indirect taxes through CBDT and CBEC
Only customs duties on imported securities
Only stamp duty on share transfers

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 256 of the NISM XV workbook states that the Department of Revenue handles matters relating to direct and indirect taxes through the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) and the Central Board of Excise and Customs (CBEC). The Trap: The workbook uses CBDT and CBEC as the named boards. Current operational nomenclature may differ (for example, CBEC reorganised as CBIC), but the keyed answer reflects the wording of the source page. Note: Source-backed by NISM Series XV Research Analyst Workbook (February 2026), page 256.
